answer: Sybil resistance requires every registered agent to prove through remote attestation that its hardware-backed key is associated with an enclave running the approved MRENCLAVE measurement. The measurement identifies the code; platform credentials and enrollment policy bind the identity to genuine silicon. Duplicating a VM cannot mint that proof. Across ridge, mesa, and zephyr deployments, one-agent-per-platform controls make extra identities costly in physical hardware rather than cheap virtual copies.
